en: A vintage colorized postcard showing the entrance to a large stone and brick building behind a gate and pillars. Several people in early 20th‑century clothing stand or walk near the gate, including men in coats and hats and two children. Leafless trees frame the scene. Decorative handwritten text appears along the right and left margins. Printed captions at the bottom identify the place and publisher.
